test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

Anna said, “What are you talking about, Mark? How can you leave us alone at such a difficult time?”

options.text: Anna was surprised and asked Mark what he was talking about. She further asked him how he could leave them alone at such a difficult time.
Anna was surprised and asking Mark what was he talking about. She also asked him how he can leave them alone at such a difficult time.
Anna asked Mark what he is talking about. She further asked him how could he leave them alone at such a difficult time.
Anna was in surprise and asking Mark what he was talking about. She was asking him how he could leave them alone at such a difficult time.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Anna was surprised and asked Mark what he was talking about. She further asked him how he could leave them alone at such a difficult time."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• This is a reported speech with multiple quotes:​
 
• The report is in simple past, so we will do the following changes:
 
 
• ​The 1st sentence is in **present continuous tense**, we will change that to **past continuous**.
 
• In the second sentence, **how can you leave** will change to **how you could leave**.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer: *Anna was surprised and asked Mark what he was talking about. She further asked him how he could leave them alone at such a difficult time.*
